examples.title: Ambient Light Theater
examples.description: Turns APDS9960 ambient light readings into a window-lit room. Covering or exposing the sensor dims or brightens the scene, opens the blinds visually, and changes the dust motion.

examples.title: Color Studio
examples.description: Displays APDS9960 RGB readings as a large live color swatch. Recent detected colors are kept as chips along the bottom so it is easy to compare objects or lighting changes.

examples.title: Gesture Swipe Pad
examples.description: Visualizes APDS9960 gesture events as a stack of swipeable cards. Each detected gesture throws the top card up, down, left, or right and advances the deck like a phone or tablet interaction.

examples.title: Proximity Bloom
examples.description: Visualizes APDS9960 proximity as a glowing bloom. Move a hand or object near the sensor to expand the flower, brighten the core, and energize the particles.

examples.title: Gravity Visualizer
examples.description: Shows the BNO085 gravity vector as a live 3D direction indicator. This is a simple way to inspect tilt direction without any Processing-side smoothing.

examples.title: Marble Maze
examples.description: Turns the BNO085 into a tilt controller for a small marble maze. Tilt the sensor to roll the marble through the board.

examples.title: Orientation Cube
examples.description: Displays BNO085 orientation as a 3D cube. Quaternion data is used when available, with Euler angles as a fallback.

examples.title: Particle Rain
examples.description: Uses the BNO085 gravity vector to steer particles inside a 3D box. It is mostly a visual stress demo for tilt direction and responsiveness.

examples.title: Light Console
examples.description: Turns the eight CAP1188 capacitive touch inputs into a small lighting desk. Each touch toggles one colored beam, so the sensor behaves like eight physical scene buttons.

examples.title: Touch Piano
examples.description: Turns the eight CAP1188 capacitive touch inputs into a soft one-octave touch piano. Each electrode triggers one visual key and one generated note.

examples.title: Distance Tunnel
examples.description: Visualizes the VL53L4CX single-zone distance reading as a responsive depth tunnel. Press `m` to drive the effect from raw millimeters, or `n` to use the firmware-normalized output.

examples.title: Touchless Resonator
examples.description: Turns the VL53L4CX normalized distance output into a soft touchless resonator. Slow hand movement gently plays the current note area, while sharper movement adds accents; press space to mute.

examples.title: Blob Tracker
examples.description: Tracks the largest close-range blob in the VL53L5CX 8x8 grid. Useful for seeing hand position as a single object instead of raw zones.

examples.title: Heatmap
examples.description: Draws the VL53L5CX 8x8 distance grid as a color heatmap. Close objects are highlighted so hand movement is easy to see.

examples.title: Point Cloud
examples.description: Shows the VL53L5CX 8x8 grid as a small 3D point cloud. This makes the depth shape easier to understand than a list of numbers.

examples.title: Raw Monitor
examples.description: Displays raw VL53L5CX row data and frame-to-frame changes with no Processing-side filtering. Use it to verify firmware smoothing, invalid zones, and output rate.

examples.title: Touchless Synth
examples.description: Turns the VL53L5CX 8x8 grid into a simple touchless instrument. Hand position and distance drive the visual pads and generated sound.
